newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak cbank sets three-day repo, min rate 8.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovak cbank sets three-day repo, min rate 8.8 pct.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) on Tuesday set a three-day repo tender to add market liquidity of a maximum 2.0 billion crowns.
The minimum rate in the tender was set at 8.8 percent, equal to the discount rate, a central bank statement said.
The NBS added 7.0 billion crowns through a one-week repo tender on Monday, with the average yield falling to 18.82 percent from 19.83 percent in a similar repo on Friday.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector as of July 21 lacked 3.32 percent of the funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements on July 31.
